case_title: MRINAL DAS & ORS. V. THE STATE OF TRIPURA
statutory_provisions: IPC s.302, s.34; Arms Act s.27
trial_court_outcome: Acquitted ten accused, convicted A-5 and A-11
high_court_outcome: Set aside acquittal of four accused, convicted them under Sections 302/34 IPC
neutral_facts: The prosecution alleges that the deceased, 'T', was killed by 13 accused persons who had developed a grudge against him for opposing a student agitation against the kidnapping of students and a laborer by extremists. The accused planned to eliminate 'T' and remained stationed on the river shore. When 'T' and his companions disembarked from a boat, one of the accused, A-12, dragged 'T' down, and A-5 and A-11 shot him, causing severe injuries that led to his death. The trial court acquitted ten accused but convicted A-5 and A-11. The High Court overturned the acquittals of four accused and convicted them under Sections 302 and 34 of the IPC. The evidence includes statements from an approver, eye-witnesses, and medical reports confirming the injuries and cause of death.
